description: Seven VerilogEval problems the domain was extended to reach (LLM_RTL_code_generation.md 8.6.8, 8.6.11): four counters with no enable input, and three Moore state machines with an output that is 1 in more than one state. The extension was checked on generated designs (check_counters_and_tables.py), not on these. No problem file is written for them: the pipeline translates each description. All seven fail the direct-prompt baseline in most or all samples, so all are 'poor'.
